question: Can scheduled input authority end normally while one bounded passive observation lifecycle continues, without any post-deadline input or release regression?

arms.baseline: unchanged session_map01_v13/executor_v12; expiry -> terminal expired; harness then submits one fresh observe-only program
arms.candidate: same v13 stack with only executor replaced; expiry -> verified release -> one passive snapshot under 400 ms lifecycle budget -> terminal authority_ended; no program tail resumes

primary_endpoints: release verified_ns -> first post-release full observation capture_ns
hard_gates: verified empty release in all six sessions
candidate: exactly one passive post-release observation in all three sessions
candidate: zero input admissions after verified release
candidate: post-release capture occurs after verified release and within lifecycle budget
candidate: terminal status authority_ended and owner interruption reason expired
baseline: terminal status expired and separate observe-only program completes
five-field score.json/direct-final-sample agreement in all sessions

decision.PROMOTE: all hard gates pass, candidate median release-to-fresh-capture improves by >=20 ms OR removes the extra observe submission with no >2 ms median release-timing regression
decision.HOLD: hard gates pass but latency/boundary benefit is below threshold or ambiguous
decision.REJECT: any post-deadline input, unverified release, cause conflation, lifecycle deadline miss, or scorer disagreement

stop_rule: one smoke pair; if harness-valid, exactly three fresh matched pairs, no retry or extension for favorable results
